manifest.name: dsh-loop-breaker
manifest.description: DSH 流式复读熔断器：在 llm/stream 层边收边判，命中退化复读就地掐断（底层 HTTP 随即取消，token 停止计费），掐断时消毒正文避免污染上下文

bundle.text:
# dsh-loop-breaker profile patch layer
- insert:
    - id: loop-breaker
      name: 'dsh-loop-breaker'

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/CHIP-PHILO-GH/dsh-loop-breaker/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

只想要“照着做一遍”的封装版本（含安装、配置与排错表），见同名技能包 llm-degeneration-loop-breaker；本仓库是代码本体。

> **只要检测器、不想装 DSH？** 核心判定逻辑已抽成零依赖独立包 → [core/README.md](core/README.md)

DSH 的**流式复读熔断器**。解决 DeepSeek flash 偶发的「退化复读」——思考链或正文反复输出
同一小段内容（`好的` / `好的，执行` / `好`），长时间不产出有效结果，按输出速度白白烧 token。

装好之后：命中复读 → 当场掐断生成（底层 HTTP 随即取消，token 停止计费）→ 同一轮注入一句
补救提示让模型重新作答。

---

readme.section: 为什么不用现成的 dsh-thinking-loop-guard
readme.text:
社区已有一个 [unknowbug/dsh-thinking-loop-guard](https://github.com/unknowbug/dsh-thinking-loop-guard)
解决同类问题，但它只有 **turn 边界** 检测（挂在 `agent/turn-stopping` 上读完整 reasoning）。
问题在于：**turn 边界 = 这一轮的 token 已经烧完了**。它能阻止循环蔓延到下一轮，却救不回
正在烧的那一轮。

它的 README 明确断言「DSH 直连远程 API，没有中间层能检测并打断流式响应」。这个判断是错的：
DSH 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 暴露了 **`llm/stream` 瀑布事件**，包住每一次流式模型调用：

```js
'llm/stream'(this: LlmRuntime, options: GenerateOptions, next: () => AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>
```

readme.section: 为什么不用现成的 dsh-thinking-loop-guard
readme.text:
本插件就挂在这里，因此能做到它做不到的事：**流式过程中命中，就地掐断**。

---

```
模型流式输出
  → llm/stream 瀑布（本插件包住这条流）
      → 逐块统计 reasoning / text
      → 规则任一命中

第二层是关键体验保障：如果只掐断不补救，模型往往只产出了半截思考、没产出正文，
用户会拿到一个「只有思考、没有答案」的空轮次。

readme.section: L0 消毒：为什么掐断时还要改写正文
readme.text:
掐断只解决了「继续烧 token」，没解决「垃圾进历史」。补 `block-end` 时如果把复读原文
（可能是几百遍「好的执行」）原样写回，它会被持久化进会话历史，成为下一次生成的先验——
同前缀同退化是自回归模型的固有性质，于是出现「掐断后重发、甚至新开对话仍然复读」。

因此写回前先过一遍 `sanitizeBlockText()`：保留开头 `sanitizeHeadChars` 字（保住「刚才在
做什么」的语义），其余替换成占位符；若**开头本身就已字面塌缩**（用字单调且碎片化），
则一段都不保留。可用 `sanitize: false` 回退成旧行为（排查期想看模型到底复读了什么时有用）。

readme.section: 为什么必须补 finish 块
readme.text:
`dsh-llm` 内置 `validateStream`（以 `prepend: true` 注册，位于本插件**外层**）校验流协议：

- 流必须以 `finish` 块收尾，否则 `LLM stream ended without a terminal finish chunk`；
- `finish.reason.kind` 不是 `error`/`aborted` 时，**不允许有未闭合的内容块**。

所以掐断时必须先为每个打开的内容块补 `block-end`，再补 `finish:{kind:'stop'}`，顺序不能反。
用 `aborted` 虽然天然允许未闭合块，但 agent loop 会把它当失败抛出，用户看到报错。

readme.section: 开着工具调用块时不掐断
readme.text:
半截的工具调用参数是无意义且危险的（可能被执行、报 JSON 解析错）。因此只要还有非
`text`/`reasoning` 的块开着，就推迟掐断；等工具块关闭后若仍在复读，恢复掐断（有测试覆盖）。

---

| 规则 | 抓什么 | 默认阈值 |
|---|---|---|
| `tight-period-loop` | **碎片周期循环**：`做。→（执行）→好。→执行。` 这类在决策点原地打转 | 尾部 200 字内存在周期 p∈[3,48]、自吻合率 ≥ 0.92，且窗口内片段种类 ≤6 |
| `char-collapse-loop` | **字符集塌缩**：整段用字单调到只有个位数种字 | 尾部窗口去重字符占比 < 0.10、片段长度中位 <10、片段种类 ≤6 |
| `sentence-recycle` | 换着说法反复重下同一个决定 | 句子回收率 ≥ 0.80（且 ≥20 句、窗口 ≥600 字） |
| `gram-recycle-16` | 大段分析反复重算 | 16-gram 回收率 ≥ 0.80（窗口 ≥900 字） |
| `tight-phrase-loop` | `好的/好/好的执行` 这类短句空转 | 窗口内 3-gram 冗余度 ≥ 0.90（窗口 ≥400 字） |
| `max-chars` / `max-reasoning-chars` | 兜底硬上限 | 20 万字 / 12 万字（0 = 关闭） |

**判据为什么从「重复率」改成「周期长度」**：前三类本质都在量「重复得多不多」，而正常的
模板化长输出重复得一样多——40 个结构相同、只有函数名不同的函数体 16-gram 回收率 0.808，
比真实复读样本 real_loop3 的 0.676 还高，光靠重复率阈值分不开这两类。

真正能分开的是**重复单元的周期长度**：退化复读的单元是几到几十字的无意义碎片（周期
4~48 字），正常模板化输出的单元是一个函数体、一行表格（周期几百字），差两个数量级。
所以用「短周期严格重复」当判据，能精确抓住碎片循环，同时天然放过结构性雷同的批量内容。

另有一个**零信息增量**信号（连续 `stallMinChars` 字没产生任何新的 3-gram）**不单独触发**，
只作为助推：命中它时放宽上面两条的闸门（片段种类 ≤10、去重字符占比 <0.16）。单独用会误杀
批量同构内容——那确实没有新 3-gram，但不是退化。

还要注意「用字单调」与「碎片循环」都必须叠加**片段种类极少**这一条：图表型文本（大量 `#`
与数字）用字同样单调，但每一行都不同，靠这道闸门排除在外。

阈值不是拍脑袋定的，是用真实样本标定的（`samples/` + `test.mjs`）：

| 样本 | 句子回收率 | 16-gram 回收率 |
|---|---|---|
| 3 份真实复读会话记录 | **1.000 / 1.000 / 1.000** | 0.68 ~ 0.78 |
| 6 份官方中文文档 + 3 份源码 + 60 行长表格 | 0.000 ~ 0.255 | 0.02 ~ 0.15 |

两类之间留了很大余量，因此阈值取中间，**宁可漏过不可误杀**。实测命中位置（2026-09-12 加入
短周期与塌缩规则后重测）：

- 三份真实复读样本：第 626 / 636 / 1723 字命中（`sentence-recycle`）
- 碎片周期循环（`做/执行/好`）：第 135 字命中（`tight-period-loop`）
- 短句空转（`好的，执行`）：第 132 字命中（`tight-period-loop`）
- 「正常前缀 + 短句空转」：第 1403 字命中（前面的正常前缀把新规则的短窗口稀释了，回落到周期规则）

即复读开始后约 130~2000 字内被拦下，碎片型复读由原来的 400 字级提前到百字级。
作为对照，ollama 那份报告里一次失控跑了 **31M token**。

---

```yaml
- id: loop-breaker
  name: 'dsh-loop-breaker'     # 与包名一致（install.ps1 就装在这个名字下）；若装在 @local\ 作用域里则写 '@local/dsh-loop-breaker'
  config:
    enabled: true                # 总开关

调参方向：

- **误杀正常长输出** → 调高 `sentRecycle` / `gramRecycle16` / `tightRedundancy`，或调大 `windowChars`
- **误杀批量同构内容（清单 / 条款 / 近似函数）** → 这类靠句子回收命中，调高 `sentRecycle`
- **误杀碎片循环判定** → 调高 `periodMatch`，或调低 `periodMax`（周期越小越像退化）
- **漏过复读** → 反向调低；或调小 `windowChars`（循环占比更高，更早命中）
- **只想掐断不想要补救** → `recover: false`
- **排查期想看模型到底复读了什么** → `sanitize: false`（让原文落盘）

---
三种装法，按你的情况选一种。

readme.section: 1) 装成 DSH 插件（本项目的原始形态）
readme.text:
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/CHIP-PHILO-GH/dsh-loop-breaker
cd dsh-loop-breaker
pwsh -File install.ps1
```

`install.ps1` 是幂等的，可重复执行。默认装到
`$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-loop-breaker`（`DSH_HOME` 未设置时取 `~/.dsh`），
也可以用 `-Destination` 指定别处。

装载行在 `$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml`。
⚠️ **插件市场装卸会回滚该文件**，若行丢失按上面配置块补回即可。
改动后需**重启 `dsh web`** 生效——本项目不做热重载。
（用 Windows PowerShell 5.1 跑 install.ps1 会因无 BOM 的中文被按 ANSI 误读而报错，请用 `pwsh` 7。）

检测器本体是零依赖的独立包 `core/`，不依赖 DSH，也不依赖任何第三方包：

```powershell
node core\cli.mjs 输出.txt        # 直接判一段输出是不是复读了
node core\cli.mjs --self-test     # 冒烟自检
```

```js
import { createLoopDetector } from 'dsh-loop-breaker/core'
```

详见 [core/README.md](core/README.md)。

它主要抓**紧邻的短周期复读**：例如“做。→（执行）→好。→执行。”这类由少数短碎片连续拼装的流式退化输出。基准中的合成样本显示，长间隔重复、较短英文周期、以及长度不足的样本可能漏检；这些不是通用复读检测器应承诺覆盖的形态。

已知边界是：长技术报告、含大量近似函数的代码等正常长输出，可能因结构性重复而误杀；仓库测试和基准结果已保留这些边界。请不要把本项目当作通用复读检测器，也不要把基准数字解读为真实生产分布上的准确率。

readme.section: 4) 只想跑一遍测试验证它有效
readme.text:
不需要安装任何东西，也不需要联网：

```powershell
node test.mjs                     # 流式正/负样本回归（24 例）
node test-false-positive.mjs      # 误杀对抗测试（10 例真实长输出形态）
node benchmarks/lab/run-benchmark.mjs  # 合成量化基准，详见 benchmarks/README.md
node core\cli.mjs --self-test     # 核心包自检

这三条就是 CI 里跑的全部内容，任何 Node ≥18 的机器上都能跑通。

**插件集成测试**（33 例：流协议合法性、上游取消、工具块推迟、补救预算、L0 消毒）
本插件运行时依赖 DSH 宿主提供的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 与
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（已在 `package.json` 里以 `peerDependencies` 声明，**不把宿主运行时复制进自身依赖树**），
只能在装了 DSH 的环境里从安装目录跑：

readme.section: 4) 只想跑一遍测试验证它有效
readme.text:
```powershell
node "$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-loop-breaker\tests\guard.test.mjs"
```

它复刻了 `dsh-llm` 的 `validateStream`，专门验证掐断后的流仍然合法。

重启前自检：

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'loop-breaker|error|failed|invalid config'
```

---

1. **协议收尾**：不补 `finish` 块会让内置校验器抛错；补了 `finish:{kind:'stop'}` 但留着未闭合
   块同样抛错。必须先闭合块（见上）。
2. **补救计数器**：最初在 `turn-stopping` 里 `trips.delete(key)`，导致每轮都从 1 开始数，
   `maxRecoveriesPerTurn` 形同虚设。现在按 `payload.turn` 区分轮次，跨轮才归零。
3. **测试用例本身会骗人**：S4 最初构造的「正常阶段」文本是同一句话只改数字，被短句冗余规则
   提前命中，看起来像插件 bug。负样本必须真正多样，否则标定出的阈值不可信。
4. **硬上限不能设太低**：一开始设 12 万字，把 9 万字的正常长输出拼接测试判定为超限。
   单次调用的实际上限由 provider 的 `max_tokens` 决定，硬上限只是极端兜底，已放到 20 万字。
5. **测试夹具会骗人（第二次）**：集成测试里用 `'正常思考。'.repeat(50)`、`'…'.repeat(4)` 当
   「正常文本」，那本身就是退化复读的形状，新规则判它复读是对的——错的是夹具。已换成真正
   多样的文本。遇到误判先怀疑夹具，再动阈值。
6. **测试的日志捕获器会吞掉断言输出**：集成测试把含 `[loop-breaker]` 的 console 行收进 `logs`，
   而断言又把日志正文当作附加信息打印，于是那行断言在输出里凭空「消失」（值其实算对了）。
   断言附加信息不要包含日志正文。
7. **「用字单调」不等于复读**：新增的塌缩规则一开始没有片段种类闸门，把图表型文本（大量 `#`
   与数字，用字同样单调但每行都不同）判成复读。必须叠加「片段种类极少」才能区分。
8. **熔断没解决的另一半是「垃圾进历史」**：掐断只停止烧 token；复读原文若被原样写回会话，
   会成为下一次生成的先验。真正的修复在写回那一刻（L0 消毒），不在掐断那一刻。

- 只覆盖 `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta`。模型反复用完全相同的参数调工具属于另一类循环，
  由官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder` 负责（base 组合默认已启用）。
- 掐断的那次调用可能拿不到 `usage`（请求已取消），该轮的 token 计量会缺失，属预期。
- 判定是启发式的：它能让复读**早点结束**，但不能让模型**变聪明**。
- 同一句短句在同一窗口内连续重复 4 次以上（例如批量逐项报告「该项检查通过。」×20）会命中
  `tight-period-loop`。它在结构上与退化复读同型，无法用统计量分开；要保这类输出请调高
  `periodMatch` 或调低 `periodMax`。
- **L0 消毒会改写落盘文本**：会话记录里留下的不再是模型原话，而是「开头一小段 + 占位符」。
  排查期想看原文请设 `sanitize: false`。
- 掐断那一刻只累积到「命中时已产出的正文」，所以被丢弃的原文长度 = 触发点位置，不是整段长度。

删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `loop-breaker` 行（或把 `enabled` 改 `false`）后重启 `dsh web`。

---

readme.section: 端到端验证：熔断确实生效
readme.text:
在真实运行时里让一个子代理去复读（要求输出 600 遍「好的，执行」），然后直接读它的会话日志核对
（`$env:DSH_HOME\sessions\<工作区编码>\<会话 id>\session.v3.jsonl.zstd`；注意是**多帧 zstd 拼接**，
必须按魔数 `28 B5 2F FD` 分帧逐帧解压，一次性解压只会得到空）：

- 该 assistant 消息里「好的，执行」**只写了 204 遍就被截断**，没有跑满 600 遍；
- 日志中出现 `agent/inbox/spliced`，内容带
  `source: {kind:'plugin', plugin:'loop-breaker', form:'notice', summary:'复读熔断（tight-phrase-loop），已要求重新作答'}`；
- 该轮有 2 个 step：step1 被掐断 → 注入补救 → step2 模型改口给出可用替代方案，全程约 6 秒。

这同时证明插件确实挂载成功。

readme.section: 日志为什么曾经是哑的
readme.text:
Cordis 的 `logger` 在当前版本**不作为宿主 Service 提供**（`ctx.logger` 为 undefined），
可选链会把全部日志静默吞掉——启动日志里能看到 `[dsh-cost-meter]`、`[dsh-turn-cost]`，是因为它们走 `console.log`。
现已改为 `console.log`：启动打印 `[loop-breaker] 熔断器已安装…`，命中时打印规则、判定值与被截样本片段。

readme.section: 对正常长输出的影响（15 例真实长输出 + 3 例模板化边界，逐例实测）
readme.text:
**零误杀**：

- 官方中文文档 6 份、官方源码 3 份（句子回收率 ≤0.24，16-gram ≤0.05）
- 大表格 200 行数值 / 120 行文本（16-gram 均 0.000）
- 长清单 50 条、长 JSON 150 行、长数字序列 0..399、图表型文本
- 长报告 12 节各不相同（句子回收率 0.000）

**已知边界（会被判为复读而中断）**：

- 结构性高度雷同的批量内容，例如 40 个结构相同、只有函数名不同的 handler、每节只换编号的条款。
  实测「近似函数 40 个」的 16-gram 回收率为 0.808，而真实复读样本 real_loop3 只有 0.676——
  **两者无法用任何阈值分开**。这是文本层面的固有边界，调参解决不了。
- 需要这类输出时，调高 `sentRecycle` / `gramRecycle16`，或临时 `enabled: false`。

readme.section: 对正常长输出的影响（15 例真实长输出 + 3 例模板化边界，逐例实测）
readme.text:
**取舍原则**：宁可漏过也不误杀。上面这一节是 2026-09-10 版本的实测记录；2026-09-12 加入短周期
与字符塌缩规则后，碎片型复读在百字级即可判定，而长负样本的误杀情况与旧版持平
（`test-false-positive.mjs` 复测：10 例中 2 例误杀，探针确认均为旧版既已存在的误杀，
本次改动引入的新误杀为 0）。开发过程、阈值推导与踩坑的完整记录见 [docs/PROJECT_LOG.md](docs/PROJECT_LOG.md)。

---

> **Only want the detector, without installing DSH?** The core decision logic has been extracted into a zero-dependency standalone package → [core/README.md](core/README.md)

A **streaming repetition circuit-breaker** for DSH. It deals with the occasional "degenerate repetition"
(doom loop) of DeepSeek flash — the reasoning chain or the body repeatedly emitting the same short fragment
(`好的` / `好的，执行` / `好`), producing no valid result for a long time while burning tokens at the output rate.

Once installed: repetition hit → generation is cut off on the spot (the underlying HTTP request is cancelled
immediately, token billing stops) → the same turn gets a recovery nudge injected so the model answers again.

---

readme.section: Why not use the existing dsh-thinking-loop-guard
readme.text:
The community already has [unknowbug/dsh-thinking-loop-guard](https://github.com/unknowbug/dsh-thinking-loop-guard)
for the same class of problem, but it only detects at **turn boundaries** (it hooks `agent/turn-stopping` and reads
the complete reasoning). The problem: **a turn boundary means that turn's tokens have already been burned**. It can
stop a loop from spreading into the next turn, but it cannot save the turn that is burning right now.

readme.section: Why not use the existing dsh-thinking-loop-guard
readme.text:
Its README explicitly asserts that "DSH connects directly to the remote API, so there is no middle layer that can
detect and interrupt a streaming response". That judgement is wrong: DSH's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` exposes the
**`llm/stream` waterfall event**, which wraps every streaming model call:

```js
'llm/stream'(this: LlmRuntime, options: GenerateOptions, next: () => AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>
```

readme.section: Why not use the existing dsh-thinking-loop-guard
readme.text:
This plugin hooks exactly here, so it can do what that one cannot: **detect mid-stream and cut off in place**.

---

```
模型流式输出
  → llm/stream 瀑布（本插件包住这条流）
      → 逐块统计 reasoning / text
      → 规则任一命中

The second layer is what protects the experience: if you only cut off without recovering, the model has often
produced half a reasoning chain and no body at all, and the user gets an empty turn with "reasoning only, no answer".

readme.section: L0 sanitization: why the body must be rewritten when cutting off
readme.text:
Cutting off only solves "keep burning tokens"; it does not solve "garbage into history". If, while appending the
`block-end`, the repeated original text (possibly hundreds of 「好的执行」) is written back verbatim, it gets
persisted into the session history and becomes a prior for the next generation — the same prefix and the same
degeneration are intrinsic to autoregressive models, which is how you get "repeat after cut-off, and still
repeating even in a freshly opened conversation".

readme.section: L0 sanitization: why the body must be rewritten when cutting off
readme.text:
So before writing back, the text goes through `sanitizeBlockText()`: keep the first `sanitizeHeadChars` characters
(preserving the semantics of "what was just being done") and replace the rest with a placeholder; if **the head
itself has already collapsed literally** (monotonous character usage and fragmentary), then not one segment is kept.
`sanitize: false` reverts to the old behaviour (useful during debugging when you want to see what the model repeated).

readme.section: Why the finish block is mandatory
readme.text:
`dsh-llm` has a built-in `validateStream` (registered with `prepend: true`, sitting **outside** this plugin) that
validates the stream protocol:

- The stream must end with a `finish` block, otherwise `LLM stream ended without a terminal finish chunk`;
- When `finish.reason.kind` is not `error`/`aborted`, **unclosed content blocks are not allowed**.

readme.section: Why the finish block is mandatory
readme.text:
So on a cut-off every open content block must first get a `block-end`, and only then a `finish:{kind:'stop'}`; the
order cannot be reversed. Using `aborted` does allow unclosed blocks by nature, but the agent loop throws it out as
a failure and the user sees an error.

readme.section: No cut-off while a tool-call block is open
readme.text:
Half-finished tool-call arguments are meaningless and dangerous (they may be executed, or raise a JSON parse error).
So as long as any block other than `text`/`reasoning` is open, the cut-off is deferred; once the tool block closes,
if repetition is still going on, the cut-off resumes (covered by tests).

---

| Rule | What it catches | Default threshold |
|---|---|---|
| `tight-period-loop` | **Fragment period loop**: spinning in place at a decision point, like `做。→（执行）→好。→执行。` | a period p∈[3,48] within the last 200 chars with a self-match rate ≥ 0.92, and ≤6 distinct pieces in the window |
| `char-collapse-loop` | **Character-set collapse**: a whole passage so monotonous in character usage that only single-digit numbers of distinct characters appear | deduplicated character ratio in the tail window < 0.10, median piece length <10, ≤6 distinct pieces |
| `sentence-recycle` | Re-making the same decision over and over in different words | sentence recycle rate ≥ 0.80 (and ≥20 sentences, window ≥600 chars) |
| `gram-recycle-16` | A large analysis recomputed over and over | 16-gram recycle rate ≥ 0.80 (window ≥900 chars) |
| `tight-phrase-loop` | Idling on short phrases like `好的/好/好的执行` | 3-gram redundancy within the window ≥ 0.90 (window ≥400 chars) |
| `max-chars` / `max-reasoning-chars` | Hard fallback ceilings | 200,000 chars / 120,000 chars (0 = disabled) |

**Why the criterion moved from "repetition rate" to "period length"**: the first three categories essentially
measure "how much repetition there is", yet normal templated long output repeats just as much — 40 byte-identical
function bodies give a 16-gram recycle rate of 0.808, higher than the 0.676 of the real repetition sample
real_loop3 — so a repetition-rate threshold alone cannot separate the two classes.

What really separates them is the **period length of the repeating unit**: in degenerate repetition the unit is a
meaningless fragment of a few to a few dozen characters (period 4~48 chars), while in normal templated output the
unit is one function body or one table row (period of hundreds of chars) — two orders of magnitude apart. So using
"short-period strict repetition" as the criterion catches fragment loops precisely while naturally letting
structurally similar bulk content pass.

There is also a **zero information gain** signal (no new 3-gram produced for `stallMinChars` consecutive characters)
that **does not fire on its own**; it only acts as a booster: when it fires, the gates of the two rules above are
loosened (distinct pieces ≤10, deduplicated character ratio <0.16). Used alone it false-positives on bulk isomorphic
content — which indeed produces no new 3-grams, but is not degeneration.

Note also that both "monotonous character usage" and "fragment loops" must be combined with the **very few distinct
pieces** condition: chart-like text (lots of `#` and digits) is just as monotonous in character usage, but every line
differs; this gate keeps it out.

The thresholds were not pulled out of thin air; they were calibrated on real samples (`samples/` + `test.mjs`):

| Sample | Sentence recycle rate | 16-gram recycle rate |
|---|---|---|
| 3 real repetition session logs | **1.000 / 1.000 / 1.000** | 0.68 ~ 0.78 |
| 6 official Chinese docs + 3 source files + a 60-line long table | 0.000 ~ 0.255 | 0.02 ~ 0.15 |

There is a wide margin between the two classes, so the thresholds sit in the middle: **better to miss than to
false-positive**. Measured detection positions (re-measured on 2026-09-12 after the short-period and collapse rules
were added):

- Three real repetition samples: detected at char 626 / 636 / 1723 (`sentence-recycle`)
- Fragment period loop (`做/执行/好`): detected at char 135 (`tight-period-loop`)
- Short-phrase idling (`好的，执行`): detected at char 132 (`tight-period-loop`)
- "Normal prefix + short-phrase idling": detected at char 1403 (the normal prefix in front diluted the new rule's short window, so it fell back to the period rule)

That is, repetition is stopped within about 130~2000 chars after it starts, and fragment-type repetition is caught
at the hundred-char level instead of the previous 400-char level. For comparison, one runaway run in that ollama
report burned **31M token**.

---

```yaml
- id: loop-breaker
  name: 'dsh-loop-breaker'     # matches the package name (what install.ps1 installs); use '@local/dsh-loop-breaker' if you install it under the @local scope
  config:
    enabled: true                # 总开关

Tuning directions:

- **False positives on normal long output** → raise `sentRecycle` / `gramRecycle16` / `tightRedundancy`, or increase `windowChars`
- **False positives on bulk isomorphic content (lists / clauses / near-identical functions)** → these are caught by sentence recycle, so raise `sentRecycle`
- **False positives on the fragment-loop rule** → raise `periodMatch`, or lower `periodMax` (a smaller period looks more like degeneration)
- **Missing repetition** → tune in the opposite direction; or lower `windowChars` (the loop takes a larger share and is caught earlier)
- **Only want the cut-off, not the recovery** → `recover: false`
- **During debugging, want to see what the model actually repeated** → `sanitize: false` (let the original text persist)
Three ways to install it; pick the one that fits your situation.

readme.section: 1) Install as a DSH plugin (the project's original form)
readme.text:
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/CHIP-PHILO-GH/dsh-loop-breaker
cd dsh-loop-breaker
pwsh -File install.ps1
```

`install.ps1` is idempotent and can be run repeatedly. By default it installs to
`$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-loop-breaker` (when `DSH_HOME` is unset it falls back to `~/.dsh`), and
`-Destination` can point somewhere else.

readme.section: 1) Install as a DSH plugin (the project's original form)
readme.text:
The load line lives in `$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml`.
⚠️ **Installing or removing via the plugin market rolls that file back**; if the line disappears, restore it with
the config block above. Changes only take effect after **restarting `dsh web`** — this project does no hot reload.
(Running install.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1 fails because the BOM-less Chinese is misread as ANSI; use `pwsh` 7.)

The detector itself is the zero-dependency standalone package `core/`; it depends neither on DSH nor on any
third-party package:

```powershell
node core\cli.mjs 输出.txt        # 直接判一段输出是不是复读了
node core\cli.mjs --self-test     # 冒烟自检
```

```js
import { createLoopDetector } from 'dsh-loop-breaker/core'
```

See [core/README.md](core/README.md) for details.

readme.section: 3) Just run the tests to verify it works
readme.text:
Nothing to install, and no network needed:

```powershell
node test.mjs                     # 流式正/负样本回归（24 例）
node test-false-positive.mjs      # 误杀对抗测试（10 例真实长输出形态）
node core\cli.mjs --self-test     # 核心包自检
```

Those three commands are everything CI runs, and they work on any machine with Node ≥18.

readme.section: 3) Just run the tests to verify it works
readme.text:
**Plugin integration tests** (33 cases: stream protocol validity, upstream cancellation, tool-block deferral,
recovery budget, L0 sanitization) need DSH's private packages for module resolution, so they can only be run from
the install directory in an environment with DSH installed:

```powershell
node "$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-loop-breaker\tests\guard.test.mjs"
```

readme.section: 3) Just run the tests to verify it works
readme.text:
It replicates `dsh-llm`'s `validateStream` and specifically verifies that the stream is still legal after the cut-off.

Self-check before restarting:

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'loop-breaker|error|failed|invalid config'
```

---

1. **Protocol termination**: not appending a `finish` block makes the built-in validator throw; appending
   `finish:{kind:'stop'}` while leaving unclosed blocks also throws. Blocks must be closed first (see above).
2. **Recovery counter**: the original `trips.delete(key)` inside `turn-stopping` made the count start at 1 every
   turn, so `maxRecoveriesPerTurn` was effectively a no-op. It now separates turns by `payload.turn` and only resets
   when the turn changes.
3. **Test cases themselves lie**: the "normal phase" text originally built for S4 was one sentence with only the
   numbers changed, and the short-phrase redundancy rule caught it early, so it looked like a plugin bug. Negative
   samples must be genuinely diverse, otherwise the calibrated thresholds are not trustworthy.
4. **The hard ceiling must not be set too low**: it started at 120,000 chars and judged a concatenation test of
   90,000 chars of normal long output as over the limit. The real per-call ceiling is decided by the provider's
   `max_tokens`; the hard ceiling is only an extreme fallback, and has been raised to 200,000 chars.
5. **Test fixtures lie (second time)**: the integration tests used `'正常思考。'.repe

- It only covers `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta`. A model repeatedly calling a tool with exactly the same
  arguments is a different kind of loop, handled by the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder` (enabled
  by default in the base combination).
- The aborted call may not carry `usage` (the request was already cancelled), so token accounting for that turn is
  missing; this is expected.
- Detection is heuristic: it makes repetition **end sooner**, but it cannot make the model **smarter**.
- The same short sentence repeating 4 or more times consecutively within one window (for example a bulk per-item
  report of 「该项检查通过。」×20) will trip `tight-period-loop`. It is structurally the same type as degenerate
  repetition and cannot be separated by statistics; to keep that kind of output, raise `periodMatch` or lower
  `periodMax`.
- **L0 sanitization rewrites the persisted text**: what remains in the session log is no longer the model's exact
  words, but "a short head + a placeholder". To see the original text while debugging, set `sanitize: false`.
- At the moment of cut-off only the body produced up to the hit has accumulated, so the discarded original length
  = the posi

Delete the `loop-breaker` line in `cordis.patch.yml` (or set `enabled` to `false`), then restart `dsh web`.

readme.text:
In a real runtime a subagent was told to repeat (asked to emit 「好的，执行」600 times), and its session log was then
read directly for verification
(`$env:DSH_HOME\sessions\<workspace code>\<session id>\session.v3.jsonl.zstd`; note it is a **multi-frame zstd
concatenation**, so it must be split on the magic number `28 B5 2F FD` and decompressed frame by frame — a
single-pass decompression yields nothing):

End-to-end verification: the breaker does fire
readme.text: This also proves the plugin was in fact mounted successfully.

readme.section: Why the logs used to be mute
readme.text:
Cordis's `logger` in the current version **is not provided as a host Service** (`ctx.logger` is undefined), and
optional chaining silently swallows every log line — the reason `[dsh-cost-meter]` and `[dsh-turn-cost]` show up in
the startup log is that they go through `console.log`. It now uses `console.log`: at startup it prints
`[loop-breaker] 熔断器已安装…`, and on a hit it prints the rule, the measured value and the truncated sample fragment.

readme.section: Impact on normal long output (15 real long outputs + 3 templated edge cases, measured one by one)
readme.text:
**Zero false positives**:

- 6 official Chinese docs, 3 official source files (sentence recycle rate ≤0.24, 16-gram ≤0.05)
- A large table of 200 numeric rows / 120 text rows (16-gram 0.000 in both)
- A 50-item long list, 150 lines of long JSON, the long numeric sequence 0..399, chart-like text
- A long report with 12 all-different sections (sentence recycle rate 0.000)

**Known boundaries (will be judged as repetition and interrupted)**:

readme.section: Impact on normal long output (15 real long outputs + 3 templated edge cases, measured one by one)
readme.text:
- Highly structurally similar bulk content, for example 40 handlers whose function bodies are byte-identical, or
  clauses that differ only in their numbering. Measured: "40 near-identical functions" gives a 16-gram recycle rate
  of 0.808, while the real repetition sample real_loop3 gives only 0.676 — **the two cannot be separated by any
  threshold**. This is an inherent boundary at the text level; tuning cannot solve it.
- When you need that kind of output, raise `sentRecycle` / `gramRecycle16`, or temporarily set `enabled: false`.

readme.section: Impact on normal long output (15 real long outputs + 3 templated edge cases, measured one by one)
readme.text:
**Trade-off principle**: better to miss than to false-positive. The section above is the measured record of the
2026-09-10 version; after the short-period and character-collapse rules were added on 2026-09-12, fragment-type
repetition is decided at the hundred-char level, while false positives on long negative samples stay level with the
old version (`test-false-positive.mjs` re-run: 2 false positives out of 10, probes confirmed both were already
present in the old version, and the new false positives introduced by this change were 0). The full record of the
development process, threshold derivation and pitfalls is in [docs/PROJECT_LOG.md](docs/PROJECT_LOG.md).
